record.one_liner: Zoho CRM: cloud customer relationship management (leads, contacts, deals) with public REST and GraphQL APIs.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 only (authorization code flow via a registered client, or self client); GraphQL API uses the same OAuth scopes. No API key or basic auth documented.
record.access_notes: Zoho CRM pricing page lists a free edition including APIs with 5000 API calls/day; the API limits page lists a Free Edition row with 5000 credits. A free Developer Edition and sandbox also exist. critic: confirmed self_serve_free.
record.api_notes: REST v8 API across CRM modules with read+write; a GraphQL API at {api-domain}/crm/graphql exists but is query-only. critic: api_style rest -> rest+graphql, vendor GraphQL docs found.
record.blocker_notes: Free edition credentials are self-serve. MCP calls use the same API credits and need an OAuth login on first use.

evidence.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
Connect Zoho CRM to any app and perform actions with 5000 API calls/day.
Each API call made will result in a reduction of 1 credit.
You can send your Zoho CRM GraphQL API query using the below end point.
Zoho CRM provides these as pre-built MCP servers, so you don't need to build, host, or maintain any infrastructure.
When you invoke an MCP tool for the first time, the server initiates an OAuth flow.

input.query: Zoho CRM free edition API access developer sandbox
